inclusions: 6 nights accommodation in 4★ hotels on twin sharing.
Sightseeing entrance fees as per itinerary.

days.title: Day 1 | Arrival in Manila | Transfer & Leisure
activities: Arrival at Manila International Airport; meet our representative and private transfer to hotel.
Hotel check-in and leisure evening in Makati or Bonifacio Global City.
Overnight stay in Manila.

days.title: Day 2 | Manila City Tour: Intramuros & Rizal Park
activities: Breakfast at the hotel.
Visit historic Intramuros, Fort Santiago, and UNESCO-listed San Agustin Church.
Stroll through historic Rizal Park and take in views along Manila Bay boulevard.
Free time for shopping at SM Mall of Asia.
Overnight stay in Manila.

days.title: Day 3 | Manila to Boracay | White Beach Sunset
activities: Breakfast at hotel and check-out.
Domestic flight to Caticlan Airport followed by land and boat transfer to Boracay.
Check in at beachfront resort; spend late afternoon relaxing on White Beach.
Watch the breathtaking sunset from the powder-sand shore.
Overnight stay in Boracay.

days.title: Day 4 | Boracay Island Hopping & Snorkelling
activities: Breakfast at the resort.
Boat tour to Coral Garden for coral reef snorkelling and Puka Shell Beach exploration.
Enjoy fresh grilled island lunch and crystal-clear waters.
Evening at leisure for beachside dining, nightlife, and fire dance performances.
Overnight stay in Boracay.

days.title: Day 5 | Boracay to Cebu | Evening at Leisure
activities: Breakfast at resort and check-out.
Speedboat and transfer to Caticlan Airport for flight to Cebu.
Arrival in Cebu and transfer to your hotel.
Evening free to discover local culinary treats like Cebu Lechon.
Overnight stay in Cebu.

days.title: Day 6 | Cebu City & Mactan Heritage Tour
activities: Breakfast at the hotel.
Sightseeing tour of Magellan's Cross, Basilica del Santo Niño, and Fort San Pedro.
Visit the Heritage Monument and cross to Mactan Island to visit the Lapu-Lapu Shrine.
Overnight stay in Cebu.

days.title: Day 7 | Cebu Departure
activities: Breakfast at hotel and check-out.
Transfer to Mactan-Cebu International Airport for your onward journey.
